name: atlas
description: Read, create, and update Atlassian Atlas projects from Claude.
long_description: List and browse Atlas projects, create projects (with goal, tag and Jira links), read status updates and post new ones. Requires uv (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) on this machine.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List non-archived projects, most recently updated first

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a project with optional goal, tag and Jira link

tools.name: get_project_updates
tools.description: Get status updates and highlights for a project

tools.name: atlas_graphql_query
tools.description: Run a raw GraphQL query against the Atlas API

email.title: Atlassian email
email.description: The email you sign in to Atlassian with

cloud_id.title: Cloud ID (optional)
cloud_id.description: Leave empty to resolve it automatically
